review_candidates.title: CTO (Chief Technology Officer)
review_candidates.description: Nuestro cliente es una empresa tecnológica de 15 años de antigüedad. Han desarrollado una tecnología única a nivel de software y hardware que en la actualidad es utilizada por empresas privadas y organismos internacionales en la industria de la automoción y a nivel defensa. Con un producto comercializado en Estados Unidos, Asia, Europa y Australia, se encuentra en una fase de expansión a otras industrias y zonas terrestres. Además, desarrollan proyectos de investigación para organismos nacionales e internacionales. Buscamos un/a CTO (Chief Technology Officer) senior que asuma la dirección técnica de la compañía: definir la hoja de ruta tecnológica y de producto, liderar el equipo de laboratorio, montaje y aplicaciones, y representar a la compañía como referente técnico en el sector, ante clientes, socios y la comunidad científica. Funciones: Estrategia tecnológica y de producto: definir y ejecutar la hoja de ruta de cámaras, detectores y software, alineada con los objetivos de negocio y con los mercados industrial y de defensa. Dirección de I+D e innovación: liderar el desarrollo de nuevos productos y la mejora de los existentes, y decidir cuándo desarrollar, industrializar o colaborar con terceros. Liderazgo del equipo técnico: dirigir a los responsables y técnicos de laboratorio, montaje y aplicaciones, fijar objetivos y asegurar su desarrollo profesional. Calidad e industrialización: garantizar que los procesos de producción, calibración y control de calidad sean escalables y trazables, y supervisar la operativa de sala limpia. Relación con clientes y socios: acompañar a Ventas en los proyectos técnicamente complejos y participar en acuerdos con clientes, centros de investigación y proveedores estratégicos. Proyectos y financiación de I+D: impulsar la participación en proyectos colaborativos y convocatorias de financiación nacionales y europeas. Representación externa: actuar como cara técnica de la empresa en ferias, congresos, seminarios y charlas, con presencia internacional. Reporte a la Dirección: formar parte del equipo directivo y responder del presupuesto, los plazos y los resultados del área técnica. Requisitos obligatorios: Licenciatura/grado y doctorado en Ciencias Físicas o en Ingeniería de Materiales. Perfil senior, con trayectoria demostrable en puestos de responsabilidad técnica y en la dirección de equipos. Conocimiento sólido del producto: tecnología infrarroja (MWIR/LWIR), detectores y cámaras o sistemas de detección y monitorización. Nivel muy alto de inglés, hablado y escrito, para presentar en foros internacionales y negociar con clientes y socios. Disponibilidad para viajar, y para asistir y participar como ponente en eventos, charlas, seminarios y congresos del sector. Que se valorará positivamente: Experiencia previa como CTO, director técnico o director de I+D en una pyme tecnológica o industrial. Experiencia en fabricación aditiva, monitorización de procesos láser o aplicaciones de defensa. Experiencia en industrialización y producción de producto tecnológico, con sala limpia y sistemas de calidad (ISO 9001, ISO 14644). Trayectoria en proyectos de I+D con financiación pública o europea. Red de contactos en el ecosistema científico e industrial de la fotónica y el infrarrojo. Publicaciones, patentes o ponencias en congresos internacionales. Competencias y habilidades personales: Visión estratégica y capacidad para traducirla en un plan técnico ejecutable. Liderazgo cercano, con vocación de formar y desarrollar a perfiles junior. Rigor científico combinado con orientación a resultados y a cliente. Comunicación excelente en inglés y en español, con capacidad de divulgación ante públicos técnicos y no técnicos. Autonomía, iniciativa y capacidad de decisión en una empresa de 15 personas. Se ofrece: Trabajar en una empresa de alta tecnología puntera a nivel internacional Participar en proyectos innovadores y consolidados, pero en plena y potente expansión global por el desarrollo continuo de nuevos productos y/o funcionalidades de los mismos. Ubicación: Presencial en Pozuelo de Alarcón (Madrid). Flexibilidad en la hora de comienzo 8:30 – 9:30. Salario: 70.000 – 80.000 euros brutos anuales bonus anual vinculado a objetivos y crecimiento de la compañía. Contrato directo e indefinido con nuestro cliente. Ambiente dinámico y oportunidades de crecimiento profesional. Oportunidad de marcar un impacto real en la estrategia internacional de la empresa. Formación a cargo de la empresa.

This role requires a strong clinical background, excellent patient communication skills, and fluency in both English and Spanish. The selected candidates will be responsible for communicating relevant medical information to patients over the phone, assisting with patient coordination, and supporting clinical communication between patients and healthcare providers. Unlike a conventional medical administration position, this role requires candidates with formal clinical education and professional healthcare qualifications, as they will be handling conversations involving medical information and patient-related queries. Key Responsibilities Communicate relevant medical information and provider-approved instructions to patients over the phone in English and Spanish. Assist patients in understanding medical instructions, treatment-related information, and follow-up requirements within the scope of their professional qualifications. Respond to patient inquiries involving medical terminology and clinical information, escalating questions requiring physician judgment or clinical decision-making to the appropriate provider. Conduct patient intake and collect relevant medical histories and information. Coordinate patient appointments, follow-ups, and clinical communications. Maintain accurate patient records and update Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Coordinate with physicians, clinical staff, and administrative teams to ensure timely communication. Maintain patient confidentiality and adhere to applicable healthcare privacy and compliance requirements. Support other clinical coordination and healthcare administrative activities as required. Qualifications and Requirements Mandatory Clinical Qualifications Must be a qualified Medical Doctor (MD), Registered Nurse (RN), or Nurse Practitioner (NP). Must hold a valid professional registration or licence in the country of practice. Candidates must have a formal medical or nursing qualification and relevant clinical experience. Language and Communication Skills Fluency in spoken and written Spanish and English is mandatory. Ability to communicate medical information clearly and professionally to patients. Technical and Professional Skills Strong understanding of medical terminology, common medical conditions, and clinical procedures. Experience working with Electronic Health Records (EHR) or Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems. Understanding of patient intake, clinical documentation, and follow-up workflows. Ability to maintain accurate documentation and handle confidential patient information. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while coordinating with a US healthcare team. Important Eligibility Criteria This position is specifically intended for qualified Medical Doctors, Registered Nurses, and Nurse Practitioners. Candidates with only general medical administration, medical assistant, healthcare customer service, or call centre experience will not meet the mandatory clinical qualification requirement. Applicants must be comfortable communicating medical information to patients over the phone while working within their professional scope of practice and following the instructions and protocols established by the US healthcare provider.

review_candidates.description: Join our Team About This Opportunity We are now looking for an Alarm Monitoring Engineer to join our Network Operations team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be part of a global operations environment ensuring network stability, performance, and customer satisfaction through proactive alarm monitoring and incident management. You will play a key role in identifying network faults, performing first-level analysis, and collaborating with technical and field teams to drive timely fault resolution. This position provides an exciting opportunity to work with diverse network technologies while contributing to Ericsson’s vision of a fully connected, intelligent world. What You Will Do Perform 24x7 alarm monitoring and first-level fault analysis for network elements across multiple technologies. Identify, analyze, and prioritize network faults using Ericsson and multi-vendor NMS/EMS tools. Escalate and coordinate with Level 2/Level 3 support teams and field engineers to ensure service restoration within defined SLAs. Execute proactive monitoring to detect early warnings and prevent service degradations. Track and manage incidents through their lifecycle, ensuring accurate documentation in fault management systems. Support incident, problem, and change management processes in compliance with Ericsson’s Global Service Center (GSC) standards. Generate and analyze network performance and health reports, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. Participate in shift-based operations to provide round-the-clock network surveillance coverage. The Skills You Bring 2–5 years of experience in Network Operations / Alarm Monitoring in a telecom or IT network environment. Strong understanding of general network technologies and concepts across access, transport, and IP domains (vendor-agnostic). Hands-on experience with Ericsson OSS/NMS tools or other multi-vendor management systems (e.g., Netcool, HP OpenView, SolarWinds, etc.). Knowledge of fault management processes, ITIL best practices, and SLA-driven operational models. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly interpret alarms and determine probable root causes. Excellent communication and coordination skills for effective collaboration across global teams. Ability to work in a 24x7 shift environment (rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays). Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications and Electronics. All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification. Why join Ericsson? To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more. review_candidates.description: Employment Contract | Hybrid | Krakow Amer Sports is a global collective of iconic sports and outdoor brands, powered by a community of people who share a passion for authenticity, impact, and excellence. We bring together leading brands, talented teams, and a culture built on collaboration. If you’re looking for an environment where you can make an impact and grow your career, we invite you to explore the opportunity below. We are looking for an experienced Financial Accountant to support Germany . In this role, you will be responsible for financial controlling and statutory reporting activities for the german legal entities, ensuring accurate financial results, compliance with internal and external requirements, and a smooth month-end close. Acting as a key finance partner, you will work closely with GBS teams, Group Finance, and local stakeholders to support transparent financial reporting and continuous improvement of finance processes in an international shared services environment. What You Will Be Doing Support the preparation of statutory financial statements in accordance with applicable local GAAP requirements across the Germany and Group standards. Prepare, review, and submit required statistical reports to relevant authorities in the Germany, ensuring compliance with local reporting requirements and deadlines. Prepare and submit financial and statistical reports to the relevant national banks and regulatory authorities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable requirements. Assist with VAT, corporate tax, and Group tax reporting, as applicable. Perform financial controlling activities for the GBS entity supporting Germany, including reviewing monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet statements in SAP and other reporting tools. Identify, investigate, and resolve accounting issues related to fixed assets, prepayments, accruals, and cost allocation. Prepare and post journal entries with appropriate supporting documentation. Analyze and comment on variances between actual results and budget, as well as balance sheet movements. Ensure compliance with internal control requirements, including SOX controls, and perform account reconciliations in BlackLine in accordance with Group policies. Support internal and external audit activities and act as a finance contact for audit-related queries. Support the implementation of finance process improvements in cooperation with Group Finance and GBS. Code purchase invoices, raise purchase orders, and perform high-level accounts payable reviews; support GBS with AP-related queries as needed. Assist with budgeting and forecasting for operating costs and provide commentary on deviations. Participate in ad hoc tasks and finance projects as required. What You Need To Succeed A university degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. Conversational proficiency in German, both written and spoken. At least 5 years of experience in accounting or finance, ideally in a month-end closing environment. Experience with general ledger accounting, including journal entries, reconciliations, and P&L and Balance Sheet reviews. Understanding of local statutory accounting requirements and GAAP principles, preferably across the Germany. High attention to detail, accuracy, and data quality. Confident user of Excel; experience with SAP is required, while OneStream experience is an advantage. Good understanding of compliance, internal controls, and audit requirements. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and international teams. A proactive, well-organized mindset with a strong motivation to drive process improvements. A self-directed and innovative approach to work. What’s In It For You With us, you’ll inspire others to embrace the joy of sports while connecting with a global network of passionate individuals. We foster a dynamic and supportive culture that empowers you to innovate, grow professionally, and pursue your passion for both sports and the outdoors. Meaningful projects: Contribute to interesting projects with dedicated teams, making a real impact and driving positive change. Continuous learning: Access our e-learning platform with a wealth of engaging learning content to expand your knowledge and skills. Smooth transition: Benefit from a comprehensive onboarding program designed to help you integrate seamlessly into our organization. Work-life balance: Enjoy flexible working hours and the option for mobile working or a home office setup. Discounts on quality products: Benefit from compelling discounts on our own-brand products (including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Atomic, Peak Performance, and more). Boundless growth opportunities: Work with global teams of industry leaders on cutting-edge projects, pushing the boundaries of innovation while contributing to responsible practices. Collaborative excellence: Join teams obsessed with design, innovation, and excellence, collaborating with exciting global partners. World-leading brands: Engage with our iconic sport and outdoor brands that help people reconnect with themselves and nature. Shared passion for sports and the outdoors: Fuel your passion for sports and outdoor activities, inspired by our athletes, products, and the pride we take in our work. Authentic community: Be part of a culture that values authenticity and fosters trust within a global community. Collective success: Push each other to reach full potential, celebrate wins together, and enjoy a workplace that feels like a community. Finance: As a member of our Finance team, you’ll work at the core of a global business, driving transformation, supporting growth, and shaping the future of finance across iconic sports and outdoor brands—all within a dynamic, fast-evolving environment. Das Unternehmen vereint das sich ergänzende Fachwissen zweier Branchenpioniere - der eine in fortschrittliche Entwicklung von Brillenglas Technologien, der andere in der handwerklichen Herstellung ikonischer Brillen. So entsteht ein vertikal integriertes Unternehmen, das einzigartig auf dem Markt positioniert ist, um den sich kontinuierlich weiter entwickelten Sehbedürfnissen der Welt und der globalen Nachfrage einer wachsenden Brillenindustrie gerecht zu werden. Mit mehr als 180.000 engagierten Mitarbeitern in 150 Ländern, die unsere einzigartigen und renommierten Marken vorantreiben, sind unsere Mitarbeiter kreativ, engagiert und werden für ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven und ihre Individualität hochgeschätzt. Mit unserer Vision „ See More be More“ ermöglichen wir es Menschen Ihre Lebensqualität mittels unserer innovativen Designs und Technologien, unserer außergewöhnlichen Qualität und unserer hochmodernen Verarbeitungsmethoden zu optimieren. Jeden Tag tragen wir dazu bei die Sehbedürfnisse und die Sicht auf die Welt von Millionen von Menschen zu verbessern. Wir suchen einen Technical Application Support Specialist (m/w/d), der als zentrale Anlaufstelle für den technischen First- und Second-Level-Support unserer Augenoptik-Kunden sowie interner Teams in der DACH-Region fungiert. In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für Störungen und Serviceanfragen rund um digitale Bestellprozesse, In-Store-Messsysteme, Kundenportale und Schnittstellen zu Praxis- und Filialsoftware. Sie sorgen für eine schnelle Wiederherstellung des Betriebs, kommunizieren lösungsorientiert mit unseren Kunden, reduzieren wiederkehrende Störungen und entwickeln nachhaltige Lösungen, indem Sie wiederkehrende Probleme analysieren, dokumentieren und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen vorantreiben. Hauptaufgaben Technischer Applikations-Support & Incident Management Eigenverantwortliche Bearbeitung und Lösung von technischen Anfragen und Störungen rund um OPSYSWeb, Visioffice, das Essilor Portal sowie Schnittstellen zu Praxis- und Filialsoftware (PMS). Analyse, Priorisierung und Nachverfolgung von Support-Tickets bis zur erfolgreichen Lösung. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen und externen Partnern bei Eskalationen. Sicherstellung einer professionellen Kommunikation und regelmäßiger Status-Updates gegenüber Kunden. Technische Fehleranalyse & Troubleshooting Diagnose und Behebung komplexer technischer Probleme in den Bereichen Windows, Browser, Netzwerke, WLAN, Softwareinstallation, Lizenzierung und Peripheriegeräte. Unterstützung bei Themen wie Datenübertragung, Bestellprozessen, Tracer- und OMA-Konnektivität sowie T2WS. Identifikation und Eingrenzung von Fehlerursachen auf Applikations-, Geräte-, Netzwerk-, Daten- oder Drittanbieterseite. Dokumentation von Analyseergebnissen und Lösungswegen. Kundenberatung & Anwenderunterstützung Unterstützung von Kunden und internen Anwendern per Telefon und Remote-Support. Verständliche Erklärung technischer Sachverhalte auch für nicht-technische Nutzer. Bereitstellung pragmatischer Lösungen und Workarounds zur schnellen Wiederaufnahme von Bestell-, Mess- und Portalprozessen. Sicherstellung einer hohen Kundenzufriedenheit durch lösungsorientierte Betreuung. Wissensmanagement & Kontinuierliche Verbesserung Erstellung und Pflege von Wissensartikeln, Troubleshooting-Guides und Support-Dokumentationen. Analyse wiederkehrender Fehlerbilder und Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen. Unterstützung bei Incident Reviews und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmaßnahmen. Bereitstellung fundierter Rückmeldungen an Produktmanagement, IT, Entwicklung, Instrument Support und externe Softwarepartner. Fachliche Anforderungen & Skills Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich IT, Anwendungsbetreuung, Systemtechnik, Optometrie-/Optik-Technologie oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im technischen Applikationssupport, Service Desk, technischen Kundensupport oder Field-Support. Erfahrung im Umgang mit Ticketsystemen, SLA-gesteuerten Supportprozessen und Remote-Support-Tools. Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Fehleranalyse von Windows-Systemen, Browsern, Netzwerken, WLAN, Softwareinstallationen, Schnittstellen und Peripheriegeräten. Erfahrung im Support von Softwareanwendungen, digitalen Bestellplattformen, Kundenportalen oder Retail-Systemen. Kenntnisse von OPSYSWeb, Visioffice, Essilor Portal, OMA-/Tracer-Konnektivität oder PMS-Integrationen sind von Vorteil. Erfahrung als Augenoptiker/in oder Kenntnisse der Augenoptikbranche sind ein Plus. Sprachkenntnisse Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse. Gute Englischkenntnisse. Weitere Sprachen im DACH-Raum sind von Vorteil.
